verdict.rationale: Mastra is fundamentally code-first (agents/workflows defined via createTool/createWorkflow APIs), and its Studio UI is described only as a tool for testing agents, running workflows, and inspecting traces — suggesting the API is the primary surface and Studio a secondary viewer, which implies rough parity. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming that every Studio capability (e.g., visual workflow editing referenced in dynamic workflows) is fully API-accessible, and a probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s across all candidate paths, meaning programmatic API surface itself isn't formally documented. missing for 10: explicit statement/doc of full UI/API feature parity, a discoverable OpenAPI/REST API spec, and confirmation that visual-editor-only features (e.g., dynamic workflow visual editors) have code equivalents.
